definitions.gloss: automatic deduction; direct debit; automatic withdrawal
definitions.explanation: A system where payments are automatically deducted from a bank account, commonly used for utility bills and subscriptions in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口座|こうざ}{引落|ひきおと}しにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have my electricity bill set up for automatic deduction.

examples.japanese: {引落|ひきおと}し{日|び}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧27⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧です。
examples.english: The deduction date is the 27th of every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引落|ひきおと}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The automatic deduction failed due to insufficient balance.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{引|ひき} (pull) + {落|おと}し (drop) - literally "pulling down" money from an account

ALTERNATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- {自動引落|じどうひきおと}し - automatic deduction
- ⟦{口座振替|こうざふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧ - account transfer (more formal)
- {自動振替|じどうふりかえ} - automatic transfer

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座|こうざ}{引落|ひきおと}し - bank account deduction
- {引落|ひきおと}し{日|び} - deduction date
- {引落|ひきおと}し⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧ - account for deductions
- {引落|ひきおと}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to set up automatic deduction
- {引落|ひきおと}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧/⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ - deduction can/cannot be processed

COMMON USES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{公共料金|こうきょうりょうきん}→公共料金：16766_koukyouryoukin⟧ - utility bills (electricity, gas, water)
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ - rent
- ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧{支払|しはら}い - credit card payments
- ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧ - insurance premiums
- ⟦サブスク→サブスク：05396_sabusuku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ - subscription fees
